text:

author: PC Gamer
text:
Hasbro takes $56 million hit over multiple game cancellations, but it's still talking about how Baldur's Gate 3 is key to its future success
Just a few years after going big on videogames, Hasbro is pulling an Xbox by narrowing its focus on its biggest brands and franchises.

text:

text:

Is that good?

text:

text:

author: PC Gamer
text:
It's probably time to update 7-Zip as the app has just been patched to fix a pretty big vulnerability
It will need to be manually updated to version 26.02 or later.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Darkest Dungeon—the original—is getting surprise DLC in August
The Fire's Edge will be the first new DLC for Darkest Dungeon since 2020.

author: PC Gamer
text:
TSMC admits it's 'jealous' of memory chipmakers' margins, but is limiting its own price hike because its customers would not survive price increases of 'four to five times'
The company announces a 10 - 15% price increase, but isn't keen to emulate the memory industry's runaway pricing.

text:

Surprisingly effective for the money.

author: PC Gamer
text:

Just as predicted.

text:

"We've reached a point where it makes sense for the project to have a new home, one that we own completely."

author: PC Gamer
text:

author: PC Gamer
text:

text:
